name: Pedram Shojai
reason: Most of his work fails the health rule: his own YouTube channel is almost wholly condition-led (leaky gut, bloating, constipation, food triggers, toxic mould, EMF, inflammation and mood, blood tests), his films and Well.org summits are health documentaries (Gut Check and similar), and his newest course is sold on burning fat. The Taoist and qigong books (The Urban Monk, The Art of Stopping Time) are a small part of what he now puts out.
